name: claude-rpg
description: Claude RPG: Claude Code skills where you are the Summoner between reality and the project, and Claude is the Daemon that works inside the machine. Work is quests, questlines and sidequests; a quest ends when its pull request is merged.

plugins.name: rpg
plugins.description: Play development as a party: /rpg:summon, /rpg:quest, /rpg:questline, /rpg:sidequest, /rpg:journal, /rpg:evocation. One quest = investigate, cast, trial, scroll (PR), the Summoner's judgement, merge.
